design.corpus: all packaged non-test .go files from archive/zip, compress/flate, crypto/tls, encoding/json, and net/http in Go 1.23.2
design.scope_note: The corpus is a fixed real-source validation set, not a probability sample. Three semantic/configuration perturbations are controlled stress tests.

published_pre_mask.description: Published 2016-to-2020 pre-target mask substitution; other controlled semantics fixed.

public_gear_table.description: Public Gear-table substitution; masks and schedule fixed.

minimum_size_schedule.description: Controlled minimum-size perturbation from 2 KiB to 4 KiB.

reset_state.description: Controlled reset-state perturbation; stress test of rule identity.
